description: The chart illustrates the task count for various linguistic categories, comparing the performance of different models. The horizontal axis lists eight categories: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the task count, ranging from 0 to 40 in increments of 10. Each category is represented by a group of three bars, colored light blue, dark blue, and green, corresponding to "better", "XLM-R", and "same" respectively, as indicated by the legend. The bars for each category are grouped together, with the "better" bar being the shortest in most cases, while the "XLM-R" and "same" bars vary in height. The task counts for "XLM-R" are generally higher, with IE-Romance having the highest count at approximately 38, while Isolate and Semitic have the lowest counts, around 5-7. The "same" bars are also notable, with IE-Germanic and IE-Romance having relatively high counts, at around 22 and 30 respectively. The categories are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
